exclusion.reason: work-ladder discovery rows excluded from independent recurrence sizing

selection.method: uniform deterministic sample from current Corpus-2 residual after exclusions; FNV-1a seed -> mulberry32 -> Fisher-Yates

resolutionDesign.discriminatingObservable: independent current-residual frequency of isolated default-profile solves above the 75M reserve and within the fixed 300M total-node envelope
resolutionDesign.negativeInterpretationPolicy: zero opportunities is a negative recurrence screen only when the full required observability envelope is satisfied; it does not establish absence of admissible-order capability

outcomeInterpretation.zero: close the first recurrence screen negative; do not spend reserve A/B compute from R00044 alone
outcomeInterpretation.twoOrMore: design the smallest matched-total-work reserve-fraction A/B
outcomeInterpretation.blocked: recover the named observability deficit before applying the recurrence rule
